verdict.rationale: Jan ships a documented, OpenAI-compatible local REST API at localhost:1337. The API reference covers GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions (streaming, tool calling) and an Anthropic-compatible POST /v1/messages, each with curl examples and sample responses, so the product's core LLM function can be driven programmatically. The documented surface is limited to inference: probes found no OpenAPI spec, and the /v1 prefix is a configurable convention rather than a versioning policy. missing for 10: documented endpoints for app features beyond inference (model downloads, assistants, threads, MCP), a published OpenAPI spec, a versioning/stability policy, and independent hands-on corroboration.
